LINK_STORE.description: Default KV binding alias used to store the current upstream target URL and the public access token.

KV_BINDING_NAME.description: Optional plain-text variable. When set, the worker reads the KV namespace bound under this name instead of LINK_STORE.

ADMIN_KEY.description: Secret used to sign in to /admin and authorize admin API requests.

INITIAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional initial public token. If omitted, pipink generates one after the first successful admin login.
